_source: nym-crowdin-translate skill — references/nym-localization-kb.md §A (do-not-translate, corpus-proven keep-Latin across all locales) + nym-voice-and-terminology.md §17 rule 2. The Crowdin glossary objects themselves are empty; THIS is the term authority. translate.py masks these before the DeepL call and restores them verbatim after, so brands/protocols stay Latin in every language (prevents the measured defects: Tor→洋葱网络, NYM→New York, mixnet→混合网络, WireGuard→Wirex).
_scope: Store-copy subset — the consumer-facing terms that appear in app-store release notes. The technical changelog is not translated, so networking acronyms (DNS/API/DPI/SURB) are omitted here.
